reasoning.document_summary: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Acme Holdings Limited and Zenith Partners Limited for evaluating a potential commercial collaboration. The agreement contains standard NDA provisions including definitions, confidentiality obligations, permitted disclosures, exclusions, term, return/destruction of information, limitation of liability, no licence, governing law, and general provisions.

analysis.rule: DISPUTE RESOLUTION - All disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration under LCIA Rules, seat London, sole arbitrator, English language, final and binding award, with governing law preserved as England and Wales

The governing law (England and Wales) is preserved as the playbook requires.
